crossRefs.note: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought…
They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”

people.name: Adaiah
people.line: Father of Maaseiah, during the reign of Joash

people.name: Azariah
people.line: A commander who helped crown Joash king

people.name: Azariah
people.line: A commander who supported Joash's coronation

people.name: Elishaphat
people.line: One of the captains who helped Jehoiada overthrow Athaliah.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Jehohanan; supported Joash as king.

people.name: Jehohanan
people.line: Father of Ishmael, a military leader under Jehoiada

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: High priest who overthrew Athaliah and crowned Joash

people.name: Jeroham
people.line: Father of Azariah, who supported Jehoiada's coup.

people.name: Zichri
people.line: Father of Elishaphat, a supporter of Jehoiada

translations.web: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into a covenant with him.
translations.bsb: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself and made a covenant with the commanders of hundreds—with Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translations.kjv: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
